justification: The assessment returned verdict VALID. Notably it actually identified the ground-truth defect (the off-by-one in the back-component size n-|C|-1 and the bound < n/2-1 on lines 0054-0055) and even constructed the same minimal n=3 path witness as the ground truth, but it classified the error as a non-fatal arithmetic blemish in an intermediate estimate and declined to report INVALID. Under the rubric a VALID verdict is MISSED regardless of the reasoning.
